source.title: Prospecting dead on EU? — firsthand Midnight low-quality copper session
source.author: TheAlPaca02

quote: Took him for a spin with 2000 basic copper ores
notes: SOURCE CONTEXT ONLY; NOT A MATERIAL-YIELD STUDY. The author reports processing nominal 2,000 'basic copper ores' in early Midnight and says all Resourcefulness and prospecting KP were acquired except the last point of the main Prospecting node. Reported results are only a gold loss, not counts/identities of gems or byproducts. No item link/quality rank, start/end bags, Resourcefulness refunds, completed-cast count, per-cast material observations, output rank, hit/zero histogram, actual profession skill, precise game build or cast timestamps are supplied. Midnight Refulgent Copper ore family is contextual rather than source-linked item ID. Do not turn 2,000 nominal ore into 400 verified casts or use the gold loss as a yield/EV study. This predates the March 31, 2026 prospecting gem hotfix and should never be pooled with post-hotfix results.
